rationale: The agent verified identity via full name and zip, matched to a single user, and operated only on that account. It retrieved recent orders, identified the Texas-shipped order, provided the correct tracking number from the tool, and accurately summarized the items to be returned. Before performing the return, it explicitly requested confirmation and then executed the return using the correct item IDs and payment method, with tool feedback confirming status changed to return requested. Final messaging confirmed the action and refund destination. Minor issue: the statement that the pet bed “will remain with you” is imprecise given the order was delivered to Texas, but it does not affect the correctness of the requested actions. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
